name: Global Time Echoes: 25-Year Analysis of CODE Precise Clock Products
description: Analysis of 25.3 years of global GNSS timing data (165.2 million station pairs) documents persistent velocity-dependent correlations in atomic clock networks. Seven independent signatures are identified including spatial anisotropy, orbital velocity coupling, CMB frame alignment, and lunar nutation. Observed patterns are compatible with key a priori TEP predictions.
